elo_diff.description: Home minus away pre-game Elo rating
elo_diff.definition: elo_home_entering - elo_away_entering; Elo update r += K*(actual - expected), expected = 1/(1+10**((r_opp - r_self)/400)); actual = 1 win / 0 loss / 0.5 tie; ELO_SEASON_REVERT (1/3) toward ELO_PRIOR at each season boundary (MLB/NHL/NBA parity)
elo_diff.source: nflverse schedules (all decided CON/DIV/REG/SB/WC games; 2016 warmup season, 2017 onward)
elo_diff.point_in_time_rule: rating entering kickoff; updated only AFTER a game settles
elo_diff.missing_value_policy: ELO_PRIOR (1500) for a team's first-ever game; never NaN

win_pct_diff.description: Home minus away trailing win percentage
win_pct_diff.definition: mean(team_win) over the team's prior 12 games (ties = 0.5)
win_pct_diff.point_in_time_rule: per-team rolling(12).mean().shift(1) — current and future games excluded
win_pct_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games; in-model handling

rest_days_diff.description: Home minus away days since each team's previous game
rest_days_diff.point_in_time_rule: days since the team's own strictly-prior game in the same season
rest_days_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN for a team's first game of the season; in-model handling

is_dome_home.description: Home venue roof is a dome (or closed retractable)
is_dome_home.definition: 1.0 when the schedule roof is {dome, closed}, or the schedule is silent and the committed venue is roofed (fixed or retractable); 0.0 when the schedule roof is {outdoors, open} or the committed venue has no roof at all; NaN when both are unknown
is_dome_home.source: nflverse schedule roof field, falling back to the committed nfl_stadiums.csv roof column
is_dome_home.missing_value_policy: NaN when the schedule roof and the committed venue classification are both unknown; a roofed venue never implies an open-air game day

ewm_net_pts_diff.description: Home minus away exponentially-weighted net points per game
ewm_net_pts_diff.definition: ewm(halflife=2).mean() of the team's net points (for - against) over strictly-prior games
ewm_net_pts_diff.point_in_time_rule: per-team ewm over prior games then shift(1)
ewm_net_pts_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games

ewm_ypp_diff.description: Home minus away exponentially-weighted net yards per play
ewm_ypp_diff.definition: ewm(halflife=2).mean() of the team's game-level yards_gained/n_plays over strictly-prior games
ewm_ypp_diff.aggregation: per-team EWM of per-game yardage efficiency
ewm_ypp_diff.point_in_time_rule: per-team ewm over prior games then shift(1)
ewm_ypp_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when no prior games or PBP unavailable for a season

pace_plays_min_diff.description: Home minus away trailing plays per minute
pace_plays_min_diff.definition: trailing 4-game mean of n_plays/elapsed_min per game
pace_plays_min_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when prior games lack clock data

pace_plays_min_home.description: Home team's trailing plays per minute
pace_plays_min_home.definition: team pace entering kickoff (home side of pace_plays_min_diff)
pace_plays_min_home.point_in_time_rule: per-team rolling(4).mean().shift(1) — current and future games excluded
pace_plays_min_home.missing_value_policy: NaN when prior games lack clock data (early-season openers)

pace_plays_min_away.description: Away team's trailing plays per minute
pace_plays_min_away.definition: team pace entering kickoff (away side of pace_plays_min_diff)
pace_plays_min_away.point_in_time_rule: per-team rolling(4).mean().shift(1) — current and future games excluded
pace_plays_min_away.missing_value_policy: NaN when prior games lack clock data (early-season openers)

rest_short_diff.description: Home minus away short-rest flag (rest < 7 days)
rest_short_diff.definition: 1.0 when within-season rest_days < 7 else 0.0; home flag minus away flag; a season opener prices 0.0 on each side (no in-season predecessor is never short rest), so the diff equals 0 at opener-vs-opener
rest_short_diff.point_in_time_rule: function of the team's strictly-prior game date in the same season
rest_short_diff.missing_value_policy: 0.0 at a season opener (was NaN before the side-twin promotion; the opener flag is definitionally 0)

div_game.definition: 1.0 when home and away share a division else 0.0
div_game.missing_value_policy: NaN when the source field is missing

travel_miles_diff.description: Home minus away distance traveled to the venue (miles)
travel_miles_diff.definition: haversine(prior scheduled home stadium, game stadium) home minus away; a team's first home venue is unavailable rather than inferred from a current team→stadium map
travel_miles_diff.source: committed nfl_stadiums.csv (real coordinates) + nflverse schedule stadium names + nfl_neutral_venues.csv (true venue for Neutral-site games)
travel_miles_diff.point_in_time_rule: each side uses its most recent home venue strictly before kickoff; no current/future venue association
travel_miles_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN until the team has a prior home venue or the venue is unlisted; never fabricated

altitude_home.missing_value_policy: NaN when the venue is missing from the committed table; every stadium the schedule references is listed

is_turf_home.description: Home venue playing surface is artificial turf
is_turf_home.definition: 1.0 when the schedule surface normalizes to a turf family (fieldturf/matrixturf/sportturf/astroturf/a_turf); 0.0 when grass; NaN when unlisted
is_turf_home.missing_value_policy: NaN when surface is unlisted/blank; never fabricated

temp_f.description: Hourly venue temperature immediately before kickoff (F)
temp_f.definition: Open-Meteo hourly temperature_2m at the committed stadium coordinates, converted to Fahrenheit; latest API timestamp strictly before kickoff
temp_f.source: Open-Meteo hourly archive for past games / hourly forecast for pending games (validated PIT cache)
temp_f.aggregation: single latest strictly-prior hourly value; no daily aggregation
temp_f.point_in_time_rule: weather_time_utc < kickoff_utc; forecast rows additionally require fetched_at_utc < kickoff_utc; historical archive rows may be retrieved later using the same pre-kickoff observation
temp_f.missing_value_policy: NaN for indoor/closed games, unknown venues, invalid kickoffs, missing rows, or unavailable values; never use a daily aggregate or raw schedule fallback

wind_mph.description: Hourly venue wind speed immediately before kickoff (mph)
wind_mph.definition: Open-Meteo hourly wind_speed_10m at the committed stadium coordinates, converted to mph; latest API timestamp strictly before kickoff
wind_mph.source: Open-Meteo hourly archive for past games / hourly forecast for pending games (validated PIT cache)
wind_mph.aggregation: single latest strictly-prior hourly value; no daily max/gust aggregate
wind_mph.point_in_time_rule: weather_time_utc < kickoff_utc; forecast rows additionally require fetched_at_utc < kickoff_utc
wind_mph.missing_value_policy: NaN for indoor/closed games, unknown venues, invalid kickoffs, missing rows, or unavailable values; never fabricated

is_precip.description: Hourly precipitation flag immediately before kickoff
is_precip.definition: 1.0 when the latest strictly-prior hourly Open-Meteo precipitation is >= PRECIP_FLAG_IN (0.1 in), 0.0 when below threshold, NaN when unavailable
is_precip.source: Open-Meteo hourly precipitation archive/forecast (validated PIT cache)
is_precip.aggregation: threshold of one hourly precipitation total; never a daily sum
is_precip.point_in_time_rule: weather_time_utc < kickoff_utc; forecast rows additionally require fetched_at_utc < kickoff_utc
is_precip.missing_value_policy: NaN for indoor/closed games and when no strictly-prior hourly precipitation value exists; never inferred from a daily archive or schedule payload

is_snow.description: Hourly snowfall flag immediately before kickoff
is_snow.definition: 1.0 when the latest strictly-prior hourly Open-Meteo snowfall, converted to inches from the unit the API itself reports, is >= SNOW_FLAG_IN (0.1 in), 0.0 when below threshold, NaN when unavailable
is_snow.source: Open-Meteo hourly snowfall archive/forecast (validated PIT cache)
is_snow.aggregation: threshold of one hourly snowfall total; never a daily sum
is_snow.point_in_time_rule: weather_time_utc < kickoff_utc; forecast rows additionally require fetched_at_utc < kickoff_utc
is_snow.missing_value_policy: NaN for indoor/closed games and when no strictly-prior hourly snowfall value exists; never inferred from a daily archive or schedule payload

is_home.description: Constant 1.0 anchor for the home-field edge
is_home.representation: constant anchor (part of the served contract; every family receives it)
is_home.role: anchor — in config.MONEYLINE_FEATURE_COLS, so trees receive it too

inj_ol_out_home.description: The home team's Out/IR/Doubtful offensive-line report rows
inj_ol_out_home.definition: Count of the team's OWN-week Out/IR/Doubtful report rows plus roster-snapshot unavailables (same-week RES/INA/CUT/SUS/PUP and carried RES/SUS/PUP) whose player's most recent prior active snap position is an offensive-line position (T/G/C)
inj_ol_out_home.source: nflverse weekly injury reports + weekly roster snapshots (nflverse weekly_rosters)
inj_ol_out_home.point_in_time_rule: a (season, week, team) report row is pre-kickoff information for that team-week's game by league rule (report cycle; >=99% agreement with the strict-PIT loader on 2016-2024); a row never applies to another week or team. The roster overlay adds weekly-snapshot designations — same-week RES/INA/CUT/SUS/PUP and carried RES/SUS/PUP unless back to ACT — frozen before the week's games
inj_ol_out_home.missing_value_policy: 0.0 when the report source is unavailable or the team-week has no admissible rows; measured 100% team-game coverage 2016-2025

ol_snaps_lost_share_home.description: The home team's Offensive-line snap share lost to Out/IR/Doubtful designations
ol_snaps_lost_share_home.definition: Sum over the week's flagged OL players (Out/IR/Doubtful report rows plus roster-snapshot unavailables) of the player's mean offensive snap share over HIS OWN last 8 active games (any team; offense_snaps > 0 and a published offense_pct)
ol_snaps_lost_share_home.source: nflverse weekly injury reports + weekly roster snapshots (nflverse weekly_rosters) + snap counts keyed by the GSIS-PFR player crosswalk
ol_snaps_lost_share_home.lookback: each flagged player's last 8 active games, strictly before the flag week
ol_snaps_lost_share_home.aggregation: sum of per-player rolling(8, min_periods=1) mean unit-snap shares
ol_snaps_lost_share_home.point_in_time_rule: share history is an as-of join strictly BEFORE the flag week (the flag week's own game is excluded, cross-team); a player with no prior active game prices 0.0, never NaN; roster-snapshot unavailables join by (season, week, team, player)
ol_snaps_lost_share_home.missing_value_policy: 0.0 when a player has no prior history or the report/snap source is unavailable; measured 100% team-game coverage 2016-2025

inj_def_out_diff.source: nflverse weekly injury reports + weekly roster snapshots (nflverse weekly_rosters)
inj_def_out_diff.point_in_time_rule: a (season, week, team) report row is pre-kickoff information for that team-week's game by league rule (report cycle; >=99% agreement with the strict-PIT loader on 2016-2024); a row never applies to another week or team. The roster overlay adds weekly-snapshot designations — same-week RES/INA/CUT/SUS/PUP and carried RES/SUS/PUP unless back to ACT — frozen before the week's games
inj_def_out_diff.missing_value_policy: 0.0 when the report source is unavailable or the team-week has no admissible rows; measured 100% team-game coverage 2016-2025

def_snaps_lost_share_home.description: The home team's Defensive snap share lost to Out/IR/Doubtful designations
def_snaps_lost_share_home.definition: Sum over the week's flagged defensive players (Out/IR/Doubtful report rows plus roster-snapshot unavailables) of the player's mean defensive snap share over HIS OWN last 8 active games (any team; defense_snaps > 0 and a published defense_pct)
def_snaps_lost_share_home.source: nflverse weekly injury reports + weekly roster snapshots (nflverse weekly_rosters) + snap counts keyed by the GSIS-PFR player crosswalk
def_snaps_lost_share_home.lookback: each flagged player's last 8 active games, strictly before the flag week
def_snaps_lost_share_home.aggregation: sum of per-player rolling(8, min_periods=1) mean unit-snap shares
def_snaps_lost_share_home.point_in_time_rule: share history is an as-of join strictly BEFORE the flag week (the flag week's own game is excluded, cross-team); a player with no prior active game prices 0.0, never NaN; roster-snapshot unavailables join by (season, week, team, player)
def_snaps_lost_share_home.missing_value_policy: 0.0 when a player has no prior history or the report/snap source is unavailable; measured 100% team-game coverage 2016-2025

epa_qb_home.definition: The home team's projected EPA per game from the quarterbacks: each member's shrunk EPA-per-opportunity rating, weighted by his own projected opportunities per game (dropbacks), summed over the lineup; ratings from an 8-game strictly-prior window shrunk to a position-segmented league prior
epa_qb_home.source: nflverse play-by-play EPA + qb_dropback/pass_attempt/rush_attempt opportunity flags; weekly player stats for position labels; weekly roster snapshots (nflverse weekly_rosters)
epa_qb_home.aggregation: opportunity-weighted mean by position among the team's top 11 prior-opportunity leaders after excluding players with an Out/IR/Doubtful report published strictly before target kickoff or a weekly-roster-snapshot unavailability (carried RES/SUS/PUP, same-week INA/CUT); each member's weight is his own rolling-8 opportunity total, so the blend is the projected lineup's combined shrunk EPA over combined opportunities
epa_qb_home.point_in_time_rule: rolling(8) player rating from games dated before the target date; candidate ratings come from the prior 21 calendar days to span bye weeks; an Out, IR/Injured Reserve, or Doubtful designation excludes a player from the target pool through any of three unioned channels: a strict-PIT report published before kickoff (2016-2024), the weekly report-cycle row for the player's own team-week (the only channel covering 2025/2026, where the PIT feed lacks timestamps), or a weekly-roster-snapshot unavailability
epa_qb_home.missing_value_policy: NaN when no projected player at this position has a prior rating; non-injury statuses (incl. Questionable), missing/unreported status, and missing PIT timestamps do not erase player history; exclusion requires an Out/IR/Doubtful designation on one of the three channels; in-model handling

pbp_def_epa_play_ewm_diff.aggregation: per-team trailing mean of the per-game metric
pbp_def_epa_play_ewm_diff.point_in_time_rule: per-team EWM (halflife=2) of the per-game metric then shift(1) — current and future games excluded
pbp_def_epa_play_ewm_diff.missing_value_policy: NaN when the team has no prior games, the source data is unavailable for a season (pre-v3 pbp cache / unpublished season / absent source column); in-model handling
